{"originalQuestion":"The item is unused, but I lost the receipt. The purchase date is unavailable. Can I return it?","originalResponse":"The standard return policy requires an unused item, within 30 days of purchase, with a receipt. The purchase date and purchase age are unknown, so I cannot classify the item as within or outside the window. Because the receipt is missing, the receipt condition is not met and at least one standard return condition is not met. The case requires human review. What was the purchase date? You may contact human support now; the date clarification does not block that contact.","originalResponseHash":"46a5130ab1e9fb509525f2605e09a1119e3c4fb22bdb2ba0e6e7633744ba0016"}
